description: Cross-language vector for base64url helpers (toBase64Url, fromBase64Url) and link-fragment helpers (encodeLinkFragment, decodeLinkFragment). Base64url is standard RFC 4648 §5 (URL-safe, no padding). The link-fragment vector uses a concrete origin + path + token object so both TS and Python conformance tests can verify the serialised fragment form. Exported from @drakkar.software/starfish-protocol (TS) and starfish_protocol.encoding (Python).

cases.label: padding-case-len-mod3-eq-0
cases.comment: len(base64) mod 4 == 0 — no = padding in base64url

cases.label: url-unsafe-chars-absent
cases.comment: Standard base64 + and / must not appear in base64url output

link_fragment.description: encodeLinkFragment packs origin + path + token into a URL fragment. The fragment is base64url(JSON.stringify([origin, path, token])). decodeLinkFragment recovers the token via a caller-supplied validate function. Both helpers live in @drakkar.software/starfish-protocol (./encoding subpath).
